messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- INC-2025-017: auth-gateway rejected every login for 12 minutes on 2025-08-02; the root cause was an expired intermediate certificate [valid 2025-08-07 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-017]
- Decision: certificate expiry will alert 30 days ahead, because an expired intermediate certificate took logins down in INC-2025-017 [decision; valid 2025-08-07 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-017]
- INC-2025-011: the ledger saw write latency spike tenfold for an hour on 2025-05-24; the root cause was an index missing after the schema migration [valid 2025-05-30 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-011]
- INC-2025-004: the notifier missed alerts for 40 minutes on 2025-02-01; the root cause was a consumer offset stuck after a broker restart [valid 2025-02-05 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-004]
- INC-2026-003: webhooks delivered some events twice on 2026-02-20; the root cause was a retry loop that ignored idempotency keys [valid 2026-02-26 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-003]
- INC-2025-023: search-indexer served stale results for two days on 2025-10-03; the root cause was a reindex job that failed silently on a full disk [valid 2025-10-07 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-023]
- Decision: notifier consumers will commit offsets every five seconds, because a stuck offset went unnoticed for 40 minutes during INC-2025-004 [decision; valid 2025-02-05 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-004]
- INC-2026-009: the scheduler ran the nightly jobs twice on 2026-05-16; the root cause was two leaders elected during a network partition [valid 2026-05-19 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-009]
- Decision: ledger migrations will ship with a reviewed query plan, because a missing index after a migration caused INC-2025-011 [decision; valid 2025-05-30 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-011]
- Priya runs the quarterly capacity review [valid 2026-03-20 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-03-20]
- The handover note of 2026-02-11 wrongly recorded Dune as the owner of feature-flags [valid 2026-03-09 to now; recorded by handover/2026-03-09-feature-flags-correction]
- Decision: reindex jobs will page on failure, because a silent reindex failure left stale results for two days in INC-2025-023 [decision; valid 2025-10-07 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-023]
- The handover note of 2025-06-09 wrongly recorded Boreal as the owner of billing-api [valid 2025-07-03 to now; recorded by handover/2025-07-03-billing-api-correction]
- No deploys to the ledger from 2026-03-30 to 2026-04-03 because of the fiscal year close [constraint; valid 2026-03-11 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2026-03-11]
- The handover note of 2025-06-11 wrongly recorded Cinder as the owner of the notifier [valid 2025-06-27 to now; recorded by handover/2025-06-27-notifier-correction]
- Oskar runs the weekly architecture review [valid 2025-01-29 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-01-29]
- Decision: the scheduler leader lease will be shortened to ten seconds, because two leaders ran the nightly jobs twice in INC-2026-009 [decision; valid 2026-05-19 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-009]
- Decision: webhooks will require an idempotency key on every delivery, because duplicate deliveries in INC-2026-003 came from retries without one [decision; valid 2026-02-26 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-003]
- Changes to auth-gateway need two reviewer approvals and a security sign-off [constraint; valid 2025-07-29 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-07-29]
- Yuki runs the monthly cost review [valid 2025-06-27 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-06-27]
